note: EXAMPLE PACK — the content below is a template, not real local knowledge. Replace every field with your own before submitting. See schema/README.md.

meta.title: Example starter pack
meta.description: A template showing the Field Guide Pack file format. Copy it, replace the content, open a pull request.
meta.author: MaxMana-Corner

spots.name: Example Access Point
spots.blurb: Two or three sentences on what this place actually is and why someone would walk to it. Write what you would tell a friend, not a brochure.

hot.n: Describe a feature and what holds there
A second feature, if there is one

spots.accessNote: Parking, how far the carry is, whether the bank is walkable, washrooms, and whether any of it costs money.
spots.bank: What you are standing on — grass, rip-rap, gravel, silt
spots.hazards: Anything that could hurt someone or ruin their day. Say so plainly.
spots.tip: One thing you would actually tell someone fishing it for the first time.

baits.name: Example Bait Or Lure
baits.how: How you fish it — cast, retrieve, pauses, what the take feels like.
baits.when: Conditions and season where it earns its place.
baits.hook: Hook size and pattern that goes with it

tips.title: Write the tip as an instruction, not a heading
tips.body: A tip should be one idea a person can act on the next time they are at the water. Say what to do and why it works. Two to four sentences.
